name: UnivFD (CVPR 2023) CLIP ViT-L/14 linear probe
limitations: Weights are not committed; download the linear-probe head (fc weights, ~3 MB) from the UnivFD repo and place it at models/univfd_fc.pth.
The first run downloads the CLIP ViT-L/14 backbone (~1.7 GB) via transformers into the Hugging Face cache; set 'backbone' to a local snapshot directory to run fully offline.
UnivFD is a linear probe on CLIP features — a prioritization signal, not a truth label; verify AUROC on your own data before trusting scores.
notes: Runtime 'clip-linear' loads the CLIP backbone named in 'backbone' (Hugging Face id or local directory) via transformers, L2-normalizes image features, and applies the linear head stored in 'checkpoint'.
The checkpoint may be a state dict with weight/bias keys (UnivFD's released fc weights) or a bare 2-D weight tensor; score_index 0 with sigmoid yields the fake probability on a 0-100 scale.
input_size/mean/std record UnivFD's preprocessing (224px, CLIP stats) for reference; the CLIPProcessor applies them internally.
The checkpoint path is relative to this profile's directory (models/); keep it out of git — it is covered by .gitignore.
